outcome: Number of oxycodone 5-mg tablets prescribed at discharge
cohort: 437 women with an active inpatient opioid order after vaginal or cesarean delivery at a single academic tertiary hospital
finding: The number of opioid tablets prescribed at discharge had no association with inpatient postpartum consumption after vaginal or cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The number of opioid tablets prescribed at discharge had no association with inpatient postpartum consumption after vaginal or cesarean delivery.
